text.p: Italian debt markets managed to hold onto positive ground with the November 2006 cash Btp notching up better gains than the March LIFFE future.

The most traded July 2006 Btp however was much in line with the future, ending eight basis points up at 109.98. The future was also eight basis points stronger at 130.55 having tracked the U.S. market.
The March future hit a low of 129.60 after breaking a support level at 130.15 and triggering sell stops. "For half an hour people were just selling," one broker in London said.
Those flows of sales were well absorbed at the 129.60 area and the future scrambled back once U.S. data were released.
The future had tested the top of a down trend line which today came in at 130.70 from 131.90 and 131.20 in the course of the week.
Three and five year Btp auctions earlier were reasonably covered and yields rose.
